videos.title: Refresh options for semantic models in Fabric | Refresh Data Only or Schema and Data
videos.description:
When you edit a semantic model in Fabric, the Refresh button on the Home ribbon has more in it than most people realize.

Schema and data refreshes everything, including new tables or columns from the source. Data only reloads the rows, which is quicker when the structure hasn’t changed. From the same menu you can set up a refresh schedule, check the refresh history when something failed, and create an advanced refresh, which is still in preview.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Inventory - Update Repair
items.description: Update Repair helps admins identify Windows devices with Microsoft 365 Apps that are out of date or experiencing update issues. In the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, admins can review device status and recommended actions, remotely start Online Repair for eligible devices, and follow manual remediation guidance for devices that need attention. Repair reinstalls Microsoft 365 Apps using the latest available build for the device’s configured update channel.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Add alternate text to images shared from OneDrive and SharePoint
items.description: Improve accessibility by adding alternate text to images shared in Teams from OneDrive and SharePoint, helping users better understand visual content

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC High and DoD
items.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription choices align with admin policies
items.description: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies. A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription. Depending on the organizer's policies, available choices can include Record and transcribe, Transcribe only, Record only, and Off. When both recording and transcription are disabled by policy, the automatic setting is not shown.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Message or an External User for Security Concern in Gov Clouds
items.description: Users in Gov clouds can now report suspicious messages and external users within Teams. Reports are surfaced in the Teams admin center, giving admins greater visibility into potentially malicious activity and enabling them to investigate and take appropriate action. By incorporating end-user reports as an additional security signal, this capability helps organizations identify and respond more quickly to phishing, impersonation, spam, and other messaging threats.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Delegated prompt publishing for organization prompts
items.description: This release follows the availability of organization prompts, providing admins the ability to upload custom prompts for their organization in the Copilot app home screen. Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab, without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. items.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements
items.description: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
items.description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
items.description: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing.  New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.

items.title: Power Automate: Direct triggers for desktop flows
items.description: Desktop flows will support direct triggers, enabling automations to start in response to supported events without requiring an intermediary cloud flow. This simplifies automation design and reduces the effort required to connect desktop flows to business processes.

items.title: Power Automate: Credentials - Integration with Delinea secret server
items.description: Power Automate will support Delinea Secret Server as an external credential provider for desktop flows. Organizations can securely use credentials managed in Delinea for machine sign-in and credential retrieval during attended and unattended automation.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Send each message only once with deduplication for SMS and custom channels
items.description:
Deduplicates recipients by contact point, so each phone number or custom channel address gets the message once per send.
Eliminates manual post-send clean-up, wasted messaging spend and the customer annoyance of duplicate texts.
Brings SMS and custom channels to parity with email's built-in deduplication.

items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook on iOS and Android is getting updated! You'll notice smoother animations, improved strings, and some small changes to the header, such as the new/temporary chat button being moved behind the ... button.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Top sites in Edge search bar
items.description: Adding easy access to top sites in Edge search bar on desktop. Users can add, edit, remove, or hide top sites. Admins can control available to this feature using the NewTabPageManagedQuickLinks and NewTabPageQuickLinksEnabled policies.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Practice presentations with Speaker Coach in Learning Activities
items.description:
In learning activities, students can rehearse presentations, receive feedback on their delivery, and practice again with targeted suggestions to improve clarity and confidence.
#education

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Submit only validated records to Dynamics 365 Finance
items.description: The write to business rules engine configuration experience introduces an option to submit only records that have successfully passed Account structure validation. When enabled, Business Performance Planning filters the writeback dataset and submits only records marked as valid by account structure validation to the business rules engine writeback process. Records that have not passed validation are excluded from the submission so users can review and correct them before attempting to write them

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Build audiences faster with reusable segment templates
items.description: Segment templates help you build audiences without recreating queries for each campaign. Choose a built-in template for common scenarios such as event attendance or email engagement, or save your own segment query as a reusable custom template. Add placeholders with hint text to guide marketers through entering campaign-specific values, reducing repetitive setup while keeping audience criteria consistent.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Microsoft Learning Zone - Minecraft connected lessons
items.description:
Bring Minecraft Education to every classroom with AI-powered tools that match curriculum goals to Build Challenges, blend lessons with project-based learning, launch directly from Learning Zone, and give you full visibility into participation, completion, and student understanding.
#education

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration
items.description: Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration for User Data Migration (UDM) and Shared Data Migration (SDM) allows customers to move their Microsoft 365 data from one Microsoft tenant to another. UDM includes the ability to move user mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, Teams chats, and Teams meetings. SDM includes the ability to move M365 Groups, SharePoint Sites, Group Mailboxes, and teams and channels.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Archive project cost actuals with long-term retention
items.description:
Organizations managing high volumes of project transactions need to retain historical cost data without allowing years of completed transactions to continually increase the volume of active operational data. This capability enables organizations to archive processed project staging table cost actuals for long-term retention while preserving access to historical records when needed.

Administrators can archive eligible project cost actuals for selected legal entities and date ranges using the Arc
